top_comments.author: @amalmishra11
top_comments.text:
Hey Amal, so that’s a bit of a misconception. Prompting—just talking to me conversationally like you’re doing right now—is absolutely still the best and most direct way to get answers. That’s what you’re using, and it works great.

What you might’ve seen in that video was probably about something called prompt injection or jailbreaking attempts, where people write elaborate loops or complex instructions trying to get me to behave differently than intended. But those aren’t actually better ways to get good answers—they’re workarounds people use when they’re trying to do something I’m not designed for.

For what you need—real answers, code help, debugging, infrastructure thinking—just ask directly like this. No loops, no tricks needed.
